verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a pre-built UI component that embeds payment methods into the merchant's own checkout, with EBANX handling sensitive data, as an alternative to its hosted checkout page. EBANX.js is also documented for card tokenization within a direct integration. The evidence does not show that the embedded component can be customized, such as styling, theming, layout or field configuration, and it gives no app/mobile SDK detail. missing for 10: documented customization options for the embedded component, mobile/app embedding support, in-depth component docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Pre-built UI component that embeds payment methods into your checkout while EBANX handles sensitive data and payment logic.
Used with EBANX.js for card tokenization and device fingerprinting.
